Phuture | Phuture is an American, Chicago-based acid-house group of electronic musicians, founded in 1985 by Spanky, DJ Pierre and Herb J.  The group's seminal 12-minute track "Acid Tracks" (1987) is widely considered the first-ever acid house record.

Acid house | Acid house is a subgenre of house music developed around the mid-1980s by DJs from Chicago.  The style was defined primarily by the deep basslines and "squelching" sounds of the Roland TB-303 electronic synthesizer-sequencer.  Acid house spread to the United Kingdom and continental Europe, where it was played by DJs in the acid house and later rave scenes. DJ Pierre | Nathaniel Pierre Jones, better known by his stage name DJ Pierre, is an American DJ and performer of house music based in Chicago. Allmusic.com calls Jones a crucial DJ and the production wizard partly responsible for the development of Chicago acid-house. The album "Container" was released on March 28, 2014, and their final album "In Position" was released in January 2016.
